meta.title: Xiaohongshu food & attractions guide (multi-city)
meta.description: For local residents in 10 Chinese cities (Beijing/Shanghai/Guangzhou/Shenzhen/Chengdu/Hangzhou/Xi'an/Wuhan/Nanjing/Chongqing): aggregates Xiaohongshu and web posts into seasonal-trending and all-time-classic rankings for food and attractions, plus a within-one-day itinerary with time estimates. Skips tourist landmark sightseeing.
